question: Should the official memory-lancedb plugin add built-in BM25 plus vector hybrid retrieval now, or should advanced LanceDB hybrid/reranker behavior remain external or ClawHub-owned?
rationale: The missing behavior is source-verifiable, but the fix changes official memory retrieval semantics, persistent indexing, config/defaults, and fallback policy that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Implement official plugin-local hybrid retrieval
options.body: Add memory-lancedb-owned hybrid mode with FTS indexing, explicit config/defaults, vector fallback behavior, docs, and regression tests.

options.title: Keep advanced retrieval external
options.body: Leave official memory-lancedb vector-only and route advanced LanceDB hybrid/rerank workflows to community packages or ClawHub.

options.title: Document vector-only by design
options.body: Close the direction after updating docs so users understand memory-core owns built-in hybrid retrieval and memory-lancedb is a vector backend.

recommendation.title: Implement official plugin-local hybrid retrieval
recommendation.body: Add memory-lancedb-owned hybrid mode with FTS indexing, explicit config/defaults, vector fallback behavior, docs, and regression tests.
